needsBespoke.why: Q's recast timing logic (whether the player delays 1.5s+ to double damage and add true damage, versus recasting immediately for a faster but weaker second hit) is a genuine choice that trades DPS efficiency for damage-per-instance, and the true-damage conversion percentage is level-gated and capped — this needs bespoke sequencing logic beyond a flat 'empowered-attack' primitive since the simulator must decide the recast delay policy. Additionally R's onhit-rider (bonus magic damage as % current health) only applies while the target remains inside the zone for a duration gated by R rank, requiring bespoke duration-window tracking distinct from a generic onhit-rider that would otherwise apply indefinitely.

options: Always delay recast past 1.5s to maximize per-cast damage even if it costs attack speed uptime
Always recast immediately after the 0.25s minimum to maximize attack frequency
Recast timing should be optimized per-attack-speed-breakpoint (i.e. simulate both and pick better)

proposal: Pre-fight: assume Camille is already at full stacks/buffs available (no ramp-up needed since P/Q/W/E/R are all independently available).
Open with Q (Precision Protocol) to empower the next basic attack, then auto-attack to land the empowered hit.
Immediately weave W (Tactical Sweep) during the Q attack windup/animation since other abilities can be cast without cancelling Q's empowered attack.
Delay the Q recast until at least 1.5s after the first empowered attack landed, then recast to trigger the doubled damage + true damage conversion, continuing to auto-attack in between.
Use E (Hookshot -> Wall Dive) for its dash damage once terrain is assumed available, weaving it in during downtime between Q cooldowns.

Use R (The Hextech Ultimatum) as soon as available (or once mana/cooldown allow) to leash the dummy and gain the bonus magic damage on-hit for its duration; keep attacking the target throughout since it can't escape the zone.
Fill all remaining time with basic attacks between ability cooldowns to maximize on-hit and empowered-attack uptime; recast Q on cooldown following the same 1.5s-delay pattern each time.
Repeat W and E on cooldown, prioritizing weaving them so they never clip the Q empowered-attack windup or auto-attack rhythm.
questions: Should Q's recast always be delayed to the 1.5s breakpoint for maximum single-target damage, or does attack-speed-driven uptime loss make immediate recasting better at some item builds?
Is terrain assumed present in the damage-fight arena so Hookshot/Wall Dive can be used at all, and if so, at what distance/wall configuration?
Does R's bonus magic on-hit last the full zone duration for every attack, changing whether R should be cast early (to front-load DPS window) or held for a burst finish?
Given W's 1.1s channel blocks basic attacks, should W be cast during a gap in the auto-attack cycle to minimize lost auto-attack DPS, or is it always worth it regardless of timing?
Which cooldown/cost values for W are correct: the ddragon row or the raw CamilleW row in the numbers sheet, since this affects how many W casts fit in 15 seconds?
